one_line_description: Centralizes notes, docs, wikis, and tasks in a unified workspace
auth_methods_evidence: A bearer token is required to interact with the Notion API. Use an installation access token from an internal connection, an OAuth access token from a public connection, or a personal access token
self_serve_evidence: If you're not an admin in any of your workspaces, create a personal workspace for free or use a PAT where workspace policy allows it
buildability_rationale: Self-serve with good docs, broad API, multiple auth options, and Composio support
agent_notes: Notion offers comprehensive API documentation with multiple authentication methods and a broad set of endpoints for integration
